item.title: Government records director rules against FOX 13 News request for security plan in UVU shooting
item.description: The director of Utah’s Government Records Office ruled that any security plans for the Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University are not public records and should not be released to the public

item.title: Salt Lake City woman's struggle with allergic reactions was found to be rare disease after 10 years
item.description: After suffering from swelling skin, itches, and red rashes for over 10 years, one Salt Lake City woman's journey to find answers was found to actually be a rare disease.

item.title: Trump says he will direct government agencies to release files related to extraterrestrial life and UFOs
item.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday said he will direct the Pentagon and other federal agencies to release government records related to extraterrestrial life and UFOs.
